kurz: Many aromas dissolve better in fat than in water. Frying spices briefly in hot fat makes them much more intense.
bild_im_kopf: Like putting a key in the right lock: fat unlocks the aromas.
was_passiert: The scent compounds in spices are often fat-soluble. In hot oil they dissolve, spread through the whole dish and toast lightly. In water they stay duller.
warum_wichtig: Explains why a curry with spices fried first tastes different from one with powder stirred in.
faustregeln: Whole spices first, ground ones shortly after.
Only seconds to a minute, until it smells fragrant.
If it smokes, it is too late.
